objective: Prove Tier-2 the way TASK-211-S1 and TASK-210-S6 proved Tier-1: drive the details affordance against a REAL python3 -m server and assert the player sees real drivers. DEPENDS ON TASK-214-S1 BEING MERGED TO MAIN -- until GET /breakdown/{diff_id} exists this stage cannot go green; if it is not on main, stop and report blocked rather than stubbing the endpoint. The web client has been wired since TASK-301 (DetailsPanel -> detailsClient.loadBreakdownViaClient -> generated getBreakdown) and every driver ever rendered came from web/mock/fixtures/breakdown/*.json; web/test/realServer.e2e.test.tsx never opens details, which is exactly why nobody noticed the route did not exist. (1) Extend the e2e's UI leg: after the pasted golden item renders its real verdict card, click the card's one 'open details' affordance and assert the panel renders the SERVER's drivers -- at least one driver whose mod_text appears in the pasted item text and whose stat is one the card reported, with no value traceable to a mock fixture. (2) Assert the contract shape at the boundary: validate the real GET /breakdown/{diff_id} response against the Breakdown schema, the same Ajv pattern the file already uses for VerdictCard. (3) Pin the honest failure: a diff_id the server does not know renders the panel's 404 copy, not a blank or stale panel (I5). (4) Do not change DetailsPanel, Tier2Drivers, or Tier3Breakdown behavior -- if the real response reveals a rendering defect, report it and open an issue; a green e2e over a broken panel is worse than a red one.
constraints: Test-only stage. web/src/** is out of scope: this proves the shipped path, it does not change it.
The suite keeps its LOUD skip when the engine runtime is absent -- never convert the skip into a pass, and never fall back to the mock server to make the assertion succeed.
No mock fixture may satisfy any new assertion; the drivers asserted must come from the live server process the suite already boots.
Existing tests may be EXTENDED, never deleted or skipped.

acceptance_criteria.text: The real-server e2e opens details on the card produced by the pasted golden item and asserts the rendered panel shows at least one driver returned by the live server, with its mod_text present in the pasted item text.
The live GET /breakdown/{diff_id} response is validated against the Breakdown schema from contracts/openapi.yaml using the suite's existing Ajv setup.
An unknown diff_id renders the panel's 404 copy ('Breakdown expired or unknown for this diff.') against the real server -- proven, not mocked.
git diff shows no change under web/src/ or web/mock/, and no test was deleted or skipped.
npm --prefix web run test:ui and npm --prefix web run build both pass with the engine runtime present; with it absent the suite skips loudly.

rollback: git revert the stage commit; the e2e returns to covering the verdict card only. No product code is touched, so nothing a player sees changes either way.
